note: Ground-truth parameters for the synthetic listing panel. Effects are log-point shifts in expected active listings relative to the no-policy counterfactual. Magnitudes are calibrated to the real Inside Airbnb anchors (calibration_anchors.json): Victoria non-exempt entire homes fell ~0.44 log points Aug-2023 -> Jun-2026 and private rooms ~0.28; Victoria exempt areas and Vancouver were roughly flat. The synthetic panel is a pipeline-validation and offline-reproducibility device: its estimates recover these numbers by construction and are NOT empirical findings.
